name: 가방에서 바로 제작하는 인벤토리 조작 프로토타입
sources: Existing Unity ApprovedBagCraft / ApprovedCore states, reviewed 2026-11-16
Existing approved-theme-v3 and inventory art used by relative reference; no original media edited
scope: Approved single interactive inventory HTML. Bag categories: sketches (all weapons; unconfirmed grayscale, confirmed color) and inks. Shared arrow/F navigation, inline palette editing, R clear, one craft confirmation, compact footer guidance. Completed-weapon screen merges target selection with F equip/replace and C store then returns directly to combat. Equipment shows equipped slots above stored weapons; slot-first replacement preserves the target. Selected ink uses its own color; other ink entries match the crafting picker. The standalone HTML does not use real saves or combat simulation. The combat-state preview uses a five-second timer after a simulated accepted monster hit, pauses in inventory, and locks equipment changes like Unity.

guideScreenshots.purpose: Permanent UI instruction figures captured directly from the approved HTML preview, plus one Unity footer instruction figure. No screenshot pixel editing.

cooldownProposal.rules: Five seconds of combat state after an accepted player attack hit on a monster. Whiffs do not count. Further hits refresh five seconds. Equip, replace, unequip and X are disabled in combat. Inventory pauses simulation and the timer. Equipment changes do not start a delay.
